semantic_candidates.evidence: Two planar half-ellipse caps bounded by an exact ellipse arc and straight chord are joined by one ellipse-generated and one line-generated linear-extrusion patch over 12 millimetres.

validation_findings.evidence: The two half-ellipse arcs, two diameter chords, and two vertical segments all have positive length.
Each curved edge has an exact Geom_Ellipse basis and each chord or vertical edge has an exact Geom_Line basis.
The no-processing STEP round trip records 1e-7 millimetres, equal to 1e-10 metres, for every vertex, edge, and face tolerance.
Each of six unique edges is used by exactly two of the four face wires, leaving no free boundary.
Two planar caps and two oriented extrusion patches bound one connected half-ellipse prism.
V-E+F equals 4-6+4=2, with exact ellipse, line, plane, and linear-extrusion geometry.

oracle.statement: A half-ellipse region bounded by one ellipse arc and its diameter chord has two vertices and two boundary edges. Extruding it through 12 millimetres duplicates those vertices and edges, adds two vertical edges, and produces two planar caps plus two linear-extrusion patches: four vertices, six edges, four faces, four wires, twelve edge uses, and twenty-four endpoint uses.
